overview: The committee addressed significant payroll discrepancies and approved new financial oversight guidelines for school-affiliated organizations. They also voted to support the city's library construction project and funded a student's advancement to an international business competition.

items.title: Minutes and Bill Approval
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the March 5 meeting and the transfer of funds following clarifications regarding vendor coding errors.

items.title: Payroll Discrepancies and Finance Referral
items.summary: Tabled the payroll approval and referred the matter to the Committee of the Whole after an internal review found base salary inconsistencies compared to the approved budget.

items.title: Secretary's Financial Report
items.summary: Accepted a report detailing invoices for utilities and specialized building disinfection services performed in February.

items.title: PTO and Nonprofit Oversight Guidelines
items.summary: Approved revised reporting guidelines and a new online registration portal for PTOs, PTGs, and other school-affiliated 501(c)(3) organizations to ensure fiscal transparency.

items.title: Public Library Project Support
items.summary: Passed a resolution supporting the $12.3 million library construction grant and associated loan orders to ensure the city secures state funding for a new facility.

items.title: Condolences and DECA Funding
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for Jennifer Tucci and approved $2,700 for student Rosalie Howard to attend an international business competition in Atlanta.

items.title: McGlynn Principalship and NYC Field Trip
items.summary: Announced Nicholas Tucci as acting principal of McGlynn Middle School and approved the annual eighth-grade field trip to New York City.

items.title: Professional Development and ALICE Training
items.summary: Discussed active shooter training protocols for staff and approved a motion to schedule a separate informational forum for parents regarding school safety.

items.title: Guidance Department Pre-Budget Report
items.summary: Approved the guidance department's budget report with an amendment to increase funding for AP exam fee subsidies for low-income students.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining, grievances, and pending legal matters.
